# Set up

One ranked list of vent-associated KOs (vent vs. non-vent Cliff's delta on rCLR) and every
panel KO placed on it, descriptively. Presence/absence of every panel gene across L4 taxa is
in 06.

>SKH: 2026-11-10, trimmed. The fgsea gene-set tests (trophic-mode panel, KEGG level-C and
Burns et al. 2018 sets) and the tie-order sensitivity were removed: with 13 vent and 6
non-vent units, a vent-associated universe, and most panel sets holding fewer than 5
ranked KOs, there was too little coverage to support set-level tests. Backup:
`scripts/_to_delete/pre_trim_20261110/`; old tables:
`output-tables/_to_delete/pre_trim_07_20261110/`.

```{r setup}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# locator: root (render) or scripts/ (interactive)
source(if (file.exists("_setup.R")) "_setup.R" else "scripts/_setup.R")
```

## Assign parameters

Same vent scope and grain as 04/05, so the ranked list and the habitat classes
describe the same feature space.

```{r}
FIELDS_IN_SCOPE  <- c("Gorda Ridge", "Von Damm", "Piccard")
CHOSEN_DEPTH     <- 4      # grain locked in 02

HABITAT_TABLE <- "output-tables/05_ko_habitat_class.csv"       # from 05 (habitat class per KO)
VENT_ASSOCIATED <- c("vent_only", "vent_skewed", "shared")     # detected in >= 3 of 13 vent units (05 rule, 2026-11-23)
# >SKH: panel features with their 06 habitat class, placed on the ranking at the end
# (descriptive, not tested; 2026-11-08)
PANEL_HABITAT <- "output-tables/06_panel_habitat.csv"
```

# Ranked list: vent vs. non-vent contrast for each vent-associated KO

Ranking statistic = **Cliff's delta between vent and non-vent sample units** for
each KO's robust-CLR values (`contrast_ranks()`, `R/cliffs_delta.R`). Positive
delta means that KO ranks higher at vents; the magnitude is the net share of
vent/non-vent unit pairs agreeing on the direction (Cliff 1993, Psychol Bull
114:494-509; Vargha and Delaney 2000, J Educ Behav Stat 25:101-132).

Keep saying *relative*: this is compositional. The ranking is descriptive here. A KO-level
test is not possible (with 13 vent and 6 non-vent units no permutation p reaches BH
significance), and the set-level test was removed (see the note above).

The universe is the vent-associated KO set (detected in >= 3 of 13 vent units
under the shared detection rule; 05 rule as of 2026-11-23), read from the 05 habitat
classes (`vent_only`, `vent_skewed` and `shared`) rather than recomputed. Units on
**both** sides of the contrast come from the full paired table (vent +
non-vent), since a vent-only matrix cannot express the contrast.

>SKH:

```{r habitat-contrast}
# built once at the end of 02 (R/load_paired.R)
paired_all <- load_paired(fields = FIELDS_IN_SCOPE, depth = CHOSEN_DEPTH)

ko_habitat <- build_matrix(paired_all, "ko_id", min_tpm = 0, transform = params$transform,
                           id_col = "sample_id", aggregate = "mean", unit_col = "sample_unit")

# $z is the transformed matrix $dist was built from; $mat is RAW abundance.
# (build_matrix() gained $z on 2026-09-27, after a ranking built here from $mat
# turned out to be raw mean scaledTPM mislabelled as mean CLR.)
ko_habitat_z <- ko_habitat$z

habitat_by_unit <- paired_all |> distinct(sample_unit, vent_bin) |> deframe()
unit_is_vent    <- habitat_by_unit[rownames(ko_habitat_z)] == "Vent"

stopifnot(setequal(rownames(ko_habitat_z), names(habitat_by_unit)),
          any(unit_is_vent), !all(unit_is_vent))

message(glue("{sum(unit_is_vent)} vent units vs {sum(!unit_is_vent)} non-vent units | ",
             "{ncol(ko_habitat_z)} KOs in the paired matrix"))

ko_habitat_delta <- tibble(
  ko_id      = colnames(ko_habitat_z),
  delta_vent = contrast_ranks(ko_habitat_z, habitat_by_unit, focal = "Vent")
)
```

```{r}
ko_universe <- read_csv(HABITAT_TABLE, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(habitat_class %in% VENT_ASSOCIATED) |>
  select(ko_id, habitat_class)

ranks_df <- ko_habitat_delta |>
  inner_join(ko_universe, by = "ko_id") |>
  filter(is.finite(delta_vent)) |>
  arrange(desc(delta_vent))

message(glue("{nrow(ranks_df)} vent-associated KOs ranked ",
             "({nrow(ko_universe) - nrow(ranks_df)} dropped: absent from ",
             "the paired matrix, or non-finite delta)"))

ranks <- ranks_df |> select(ko_id, delta_vent) |> deframe()
```

## Sign check

A positive delta has to mean higher at vents. Check it against the CLR means of
the two extreme KOs rather than trusting the convention, since an inverted sign
would flip every NES in the table with no other symptom.

```{r delta-sign-check}
sign_check <- ranks_df |>
  slice(c(1, n())) |>
  mutate(mean_clr_vent    = map_dbl(ko_id, \(k) mean(ko_habitat_z[unit_is_vent, k])),
         mean_clr_nonvent = map_dbl(ko_id, \(k) mean(ko_habitat_z[!unit_is_vent, k])),
         agrees           = sign(delta_vent) == sign(mean_clr_vent - mean_clr_nonvent))

sign_check

stopifnot(all(sign_check$agrees))
```

# Panel features on the ranking (descriptive, not tested)

Each KO-matched panel feature from 06, with its Cliff's delta (vent vs. non-vent, the
statistic ranked above) and its 06 habitat class. The delta is shown for every panel KO in
the paired matrix, not only the vent-associated universe that is ranked above;
`in_ranked_universe` marks which are in the vent-associated ranked universe. Pfam-matched features have no KO column in
the matrix and are left out. rCLR leaves zeros at 0, so a KO absent from a unit sits at
that unit's average, which pulls deltas of sparse KOs toward zero.

>SKH: added 2026-11-08.

```{r panel-on-ranking}
#| message: true
panel_habitat <- read_csv(PANEL_HABITAT, show_col_types = FALSE)

panel_delta <- panel_habitat |>
  filter(match_type == "ko") |>
  select(feature_id, feature_lab, category, primary_category, shared, shared_modes, subcategory, gene,
         habitat_class, n_det_vent, n_det_nonvent) |>
  left_join(ko_habitat_delta, by = c("feature_id" = "ko_id")) |>
  mutate(in_ranked_universe = feature_id %in% names(ranks),
         habitat_class = factor(habitat_class,
                                levels = c("vent_only", "vent_skewed", "shared", "nonvent_skewed",
                                           "nonvent_only", "below_filter", "not_detected")))

message(glue("{sum(!is.na(panel_delta$delta_vent))} of {nrow(panel_delta)} panel KOs have a delta | ",
             "{sum(panel_delta$in_ranked_universe)} are in the ranked universe"))

panel_delta |>
  filter(!is.na(delta_vent)) |>
  summarise(n = n(), median_delta = median(delta_vent),
            n_higher_vent = sum(delta_vent > 0), .by = primary_category)

write_csv(panel_delta, "output-tables/07_panel_ko_delta.csv")
```
### Figure S7.

```{r fig-panel-on-ranking}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 22
class_pal <- c(vent_only = "#b74a70", vent_skewed = "#dba3b8", shared = "grey45",
               nonvent_skewed = "#9cc2c2", nonvent_only = "#346D6E",
               below_filter = "grey85", not_detected = "white")

fig_panel_ranking <- panel_delta |>
  filter(!is.na(delta_vent)) |>
  # regex kept outside glue(): glue re-parses its {} text, which turns "\\(" into an invalid "\("
  mutate(gene_short = str_remove(gene, " \\(.*$"),
         # >SKH: 2026-11-12 shared-mode KOs sit under heterotrophy/phagotrophy with a dagger
         label = fct_reorder(paste0(feature_lab,   # from 06; KEGG symbol added for family labels
                                    if_else(shared, "\u2020", "")), delta_vent),
         mode  = str_wrap(primary_category, 12)) |>
  # >SKH: 2026-11-22 shape dropped (it repeated fill: every in-universe KO is shared or
  # vent_skewed); empty classes dropped from the key; key titled for the paper
  ggplot(aes(delta_vent, label, fill = habitat_class)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_point(size = 2, shape = 21, colour = "grey20") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = class_pal, name = "Habitat class", drop = TRUE) +
  facet_grid(mode ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Cliff's delta on rCLR (positive = higher at vents)", y = NULL,
       caption = "\u2020 also in another trophic mode") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black"))
fig_panel_ranking
# ggsave("figures/07-panel-on-ranking.svg", fig_panel_ranking, width = 7, height = 22)
```

> Supplemental: panel KOs on the vent/non-vent ranking (`07_panel_ko_delta.csv`).
> Descriptive, per KO; no set-level test.

# QC

```{r qc}
stopifnot(
  !anyDuplicated(names(ranks)),                     # ranked list keyed uniquely
  all(is.finite(ranks)),
  all(abs(ranks) <= 1),                             # Cliff's delta is bounded [-1, 1]
  setequal(names(ranks), ranks_df$ko_id),
  !anyDuplicated(panel_delta$feature_id),
  all(abs(panel_delta$delta_vent) <= 1, na.rm = TRUE)
)
```
